name: Rotini Pasta with "Super Veggie Powered" Marinara Sauce & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 yellow bell pepper
1 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and roughly chop carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Trim and roughly chop zucchini. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and roughly chop onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
When the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add tomatoes to the pot; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very soft, 15 minutes more.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
When the veggies are very soft, using a hand blender, purée the sauce until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return sauce to the pot.)
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls, then top with sauce and Parmesan. Enjoy!
